translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year of Yuanhe, the Revenue Office memorialized: "The generals and soldiers of Yan Prefecture, Bin Prefecture, and Jingyuan Circuit request that, following the local commoners' precedent, they consume salt from the Black and White pools.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yuanhe 5 (810), the Revenue Office memorialized: "The generals and soldiers of Yan Prefecture, Bin Prefecture, and Jingyuan Circuit request that, following the local commoners' precedent, they consume salt from the Black and White pools.

sentences.zh: 」六年閏十二月，度支盧坦奏：「河中兩池顆鹽，敕文只許於京畿、鳳翔、陝、虢、河中澤潞、河南許汝等十五州界內糶貨。

translations.literal: " In the intercalary twelfth month of the sixth year, Revenue Commissioner Lu Tan memorialized: "The granular salt of the two pools in Hezhong — the edict permits sale only within the boundaries of fifteen prefectures: the capital region, Fengxiang, Shaan, Guo, Hezhong, Ze, Lu, Henan, Xu, Ru, and others.

sentences.zh: 比來因循，兼越興、鳳、文、成等六州。

translations.literal: Of late, through inertia, sales have also extended into the six prefectures of Yue, Xing, Feng, Wen, and Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Of late, through inertia, sales have also extended into the six prefectures of Yue, Xing, Feng, Wen, and Cheng.

translations.literal: Your subject sent documents to investigate and verify, and received a report from the Jiannan West Circuit observation commissioner: the salt of Guo and Lang prefectures supplies local households and markets in the southern Ba commanderies, and also feeds the army's horses and men — there is already a shortfall; if several more prefectures are added, shortage will naturally follow.

translations.literal: Your subject also received petitions of complaint from the elders of Xingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject also received petitions of complaint from the elders of Xingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 臣今商量，河中鹽請放入六州界糶貨。

translations.literal: Your subject now proposes that Hezhong salt be permitted for sale within the boundaries of the six prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject now proposes that Hezhong salt be permitted for sale within the boundaries of the six prefectures.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year, Revenue Commissioner Huangfu Bo memorialized to raise the assessed price of salt in the four inner garrison superintendencies, Eastern and Western Sichuan, and Jiannan West Circuit, to benefit military supply.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Yuanhe 10 (815), Revenue Commissioner Huangfu Bo memorialized to raise the assessed price of salt in the four inner garrison superintendencies, Eastern and Western Sichuan, and Jiannan West Circuit, to benefit military supply.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Salt and Iron Commissioner Cheng Yi memorialized: "The various prefectures and circuits that previously requested establishment of tea-and-salt shops to collect taxes —
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 13 (818), Salt and Iron Commissioner Cheng Yi memorialized: "The various prefectures and circuits that previously requested establishment of tea-and-salt shops to collect taxes —

sentences.zh: 伏准今年正月一日赦文，其諸州府因用兵已來，或慮有權置職名，及擅加科配，事非常制，一切禁斷者。

translations.literal: respectfully in accordance with this year's amnesty of the first day of the first month, whereby the various prefectures and circuits, since the outbreak of war, fearing unauthorized posts or unauthorized additional levies beyond regular statutes — all such matters are forbidden —
translations.idiomatic: respectfully in accordance with this year's amnesty of the first day of the first month, whereby the various prefectures and circuits, since the outbreak of war, fearing unauthorized posts or unauthorized additional levies beyond regular statutes — all such matters are forbidden —

sentences.zh: 伏以榷稅茶鹽，本資財賦，贍濟軍鎮，蓋是從權。

translations.literal: respectfully, monopoly taxation of tea and salt originally funds revenue and supports military garrisons — this was an expedient measure.
translations.idiomatic: respectfully, monopoly taxation of tea and salt originally funds revenue and supports military garrisons — this was an expedient measure.

sentences.zh: 昨兵罷，自合便停，事久實為重斂。

translations.literal: Now that warfare has ceased, it should properly be stopped at once; continued over time it has truly become oppressive taxation.
translations.idiomatic: Now that warfare has ceased, it should properly be stopped at once; continued over time it has truly become oppressive taxation.

sentences.zh: 其諸道先所置店及收諸色錢物等，雖非擅加，且異常制，伏請准赦文勒停。

translations.literal: The shops previously established in the various circuits and the collection of goods and cash of every sort — though not unauthorized additions, they are nonetheless beyond regular statutes; we respectfully request that, in accordance with the amnesty, they be ordered halted.
translations.idiomatic: The shops previously established in the various circuits and the collection of goods and cash of every sort — though not unauthorized additions, they are nonetheless beyond regular statutes; we respectfully request that, in accordance with the amnesty, they be ordered halted.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourteenth year, the three prefectures of Yun, Qing, and Yan each established salt monopoly offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yuanhe 14 (819), the three prefectures of Yun, Qing, and Yan each established salt monopoly offices.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年三月，敕：「河朔初平，人希德澤，且務寬泰，使之獲安。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Changqing, an edict [stated]: "The Hebei region has just been pacified; the people scarcely know imperial grace — for the present let policy be broad and generous, that they may find peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Changqing 1 (821), an edict declared: "The Hebei region has just been pacified; the people scarcely know imperial grace — for the present let policy be broad and generous, that they may find peace.

sentences.zh: 其河北榷鹽法且權停。

translations.literal: The Hebei salt monopoly law is for the present to be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The Hebei salt monopoly law is for the present to be suspended.

sentences.zh: 仍令度支與鎮冀、魏博等道節度審察商量，如能約計課利錢數，分付榷鹽院，亦任穩便。

translations.literal: Still order the Revenue Office together with the military commissioners of Zhenji, Weibo, and other circuits to examine and deliberate; if they can estimate the quota of monopoly revenue and deliver it to the monopoly office, that too is permitted as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Still order the Revenue Office together with the military commissioners of Zhenji, Weibo, and other circuits to examine and deliberate; if they can estimate the quota of monopoly revenue and deliver it to the monopoly office, that too is permitted as convenient.

sentences.zh: 」自天寶末兵興以來，河北鹽法，羈縻而已。

translations.literal: " From the outbreak of war at the end of the Tianbao era, the Hebei salt law was loosely enforced only.
translations.idiomatic: From the outbreak of war at the end of the Tianbao era, the Hebei salt law was loosely enforced only.

translations.literal: By the Yuanhe era, Huangfu Bo memorialized to establish taxed-salt offices, matching the monopoly profits of the Jiang-Huai two pools; the people suffered under prohibition violations, and military garrisons repeatedly appealed — hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: By the Yuanhe era, Huangfu Bo memorialized to establish taxed-salt offices, matching the monopoly profits of the Jiang-Huai two pools; the people suffered under prohibition violations, and military garrisons repeatedly appealed — hence this order.

sentences.zh: 其月，鹽鐵使王播奏：「揚州、白沙兩處納榷場，請依舊為院。

translations.idiomatic: That month, Salt and Iron Commissioner Wang Bo memorialized: "The two monopoly collection points at Yangzhou and Baisha — request that they be restored as offices as before.

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "Where salt offices sell salt to merchants, request that each dou be increased by fifty cash, making three hundred cash in all with the former price;

translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Salt-boiling households, salt merchants, and the clerks and runners of salt offices and boiling stations — under prior edicts, apart from the two taxes, no corvée or harassment is permitted.

translations.idiomatic: Now request that any further violations be punished by demotion and salary forfeiture of the county magistrate and prefect.

translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, an edict [stated]: "When arms are first stilled, monopoly revenue is still needed; when common households are heavily burdened, it may be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Changqing 2 (822), an edict declared: "When arms are first stilled, monopoly revenue is still needed; when common households are heavily burdened, it may be remitted.

sentences.zh: 如聞淄青、兗、鄆三道，往來糶鹽價錢，近取七十萬貫，軍資給費，優贍有餘。

translations.literal: It is heard that in the three circuits of Ziqing, Yan, and Yun, the cash from salt sales in recent years has reached seven hundred thousand strings — military supplies are amply provided with surplus.
translations.idiomatic: It is heard that in the three circuits of Ziqing, Yan, and Yun, the cash from salt sales in recent years has reached seven hundred thousand strings — military supplies are amply provided with surplus.

translations.literal: Since the Salt and Iron Commissioner took over management, military headquarters have suddenly lost this profit.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Salt and Iron Commissioner took over management, military headquarters have suddenly lost this profit.

sentences.zh: 遂使經行陣者有停糧之怨，服隴畝者有加稅之嗟，犯鹽禁者困鞭撻之刑，理生業者乏蠶醬之具。

translations.literal: Thus those who travel the camps complain of halted rations; those who work the fields sigh at added taxes; violators of the salt ban suffer the lash; those who manage livelihoods lack silkworms and sauce.
translations.idiomatic: Thus those who travel the camps complain of halted rations; those who work the fields sigh at added taxes; violators of the salt ban suffer the lash; those who manage livelihoods lack silkworms and sauce.

sentences.zh: 雖縣官受利，而郡府益空。

translations.literal: Though the state treasury receives profit, prefecture and circuit offices grow ever emptier.
translations.idiomatic: Though the state treasury receives profit, prefecture and circuit offices grow ever emptier.

sentences.zh: 俾人獲安寧，我因節用。

translations.literal: That the people may find peace, We therefore economize.
translations.idiomatic: That the people may find peace, We therefore economize.

sentences.zh: 其鹽鐵先於淄青、兗、鄆等道管內置小鋪糶鹽，巡院納榷，起今年五月一日已後，一切並停。

translations.literal: The Salt and Iron Office's prior establishment of small shops to sell salt and patrol offices to collect monopoly dues within the circuits of Ziqing, Yan, Yun, and others — from the first day of the fifth month of this year onward, all are halted together.
translations.idiomatic: The Salt and Iron Office's prior establishment of small shops to sell salt and patrol offices to collect monopoly dues within the circuits of Ziqing, Yan, Yun, and others — from the first day of the fifth month of this year onward, all are halted together.

sentences.zh: 仍各委本道約校比來節度使自收管充軍府逐急用度，及均減管內貧下百姓兩稅錢數。

translations.literal: Each circuit is still entrusted to estimate recent revenues that the military commissioner has collected for urgent military expenses, and to reduce the two-tax assessments for poor commoners within the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Each circuit is still entrusted to estimate recent revenues that the military commissioner has collected for urgent military expenses, and to reduce the two-tax assessments for poor commoners within the circuit.

sentences.zh: 至年終，各具糶鹽所得錢，並均減兩稅。

translations.literal: By year's end, report separately the cash obtained from salt sales and the reductions to the two taxes.
translations.idiomatic: By year's end, report separately the cash obtained from salt sales and the reductions to the two taxes.

sentences.zh: 奏聞。

translations.literal: Report to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Report to the throne.
Close of edict.

sentences.zh: 安邑、解縣兩池，舊置榷鹽使，仍各別置院官。

translations.literal: The two pools at Anyi and Jiexian formerly had salt monopoly commissioners; each also had separate office officials.
translations.idiomatic: The two pools at Anyi and Jiexian formerly had salt monopoly commissioners; each also had separate office officials.

sentences.zh: 元和三年七月，復以安邑、解縣兩池留後為榷鹽使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Yuanhe, the pool superintendents of Anyi and Jiexian were again made salt monopoly commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Yuanhe 3 (808), the pool superintendents of Anyi and Jiexian were again made salt monopoly commissioners.

sentences.zh: 先是，兩池鹽務隸度支，其職視諸道巡院。

translations.literal: Earlier, salt affairs of the two pools were subordinate to the Revenue Office; the post ranked with the patrol offices of the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, salt affairs of the two pools were subordinate to the Revenue Office; the post ranked with the patrol offices of the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 貞元十六年，史牟以金部郎中主池務，恥同諸院，遂奏置使額。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Zhenyuan, Shi Mou, as Director of the Gold Department, supervised pool affairs; ashamed to rank with the various patrol offices, he memorialized to establish a commissioner's quota.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 16 (800), Shi Mou, as Director of the Gold Department, supervised pool affairs; ashamed to rank with the various patrol offices, he memorialized to establish a commissioner's quota.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，鹽鐵、度支合為一使，以杜佑兼領。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, the Salt and Iron and Revenue offices were merged into one commissioner; Du You held both posts concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, the Salt and Iron and Revenue offices were merged into one commissioner; Du You held both posts concurrently.

sentences.zh: 佑以度支既稱使，其所管不宜更有使名，遂與東渭橋使同奏，罷之。

translations.literal: You held that since the Revenue Office already bore the title of commissioner, what it supervised should not again bear a commissioner's name; together with the Dongwei Bridge commissioner he memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: You held that since the Revenue Office already bore the title of commissioner, what it supervised should not again bear a commissioner's name; together with the Dongwei Bridge commissioner he memorialized to abolish it.

sentences.zh: 至是，裴均主池務，職轉繁劇，復有是請。

translations.literal: At this time Pei Jun supervised pool affairs; duties grew ever more complex, and the request was renewed.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Pei Jun supervised pool affairs; duties grew ever more complex, and the request was renewed.

sentences.zh: 大和三年四月，敕安邑、解縣兩池榷課，以實錢一百萬貫為定額。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Dahe, an edict fixed the monopoly levy of the two pools at Anyi and Jiexian at one million strings of actual cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Dahe 3 (829), an edict fixed the monopoly levy of the two pools at Anyi and Jiexian at one million strings of actual cash.

sentences.zh: 至大中二年正月，敕但取匹段精好，不必計舊額錢數。

translations.literal: By the first month of the second year of Dazhong, an edict declared that only fine bolts of cloth need be taken — the old cash quota need not be counted.
translations.idiomatic: By the first month of Dazhong 2 (848), an edict declared that only fine bolts of cloth need be taken — the old cash quota need not be counted.

sentences.zh: 及大中年，度支奏納榷利一百二十一萬五千餘貫。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong era, the Revenue Office reported monopoly profits submitted at 1,215,000-plus strings.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dazhong era, the Revenue Office reported monopoly profits submitted at 1,215,000-plus strings.

sentences.zh: 女鹽池在解縣，朝邑小池在同州，鹵池在京兆府奉先縣，並禁斷不榷。

translations.literal: The Female Salt Pool is in Jiexian; the small pool at Chaoyi is in Tong Prefecture; the brine pool is in Fengxian County, Jingzhao Prefecture — all are prohibited and not subject to monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: The Female Salt Pool is in Jiexian; the small pool at Chaoyi is in Tong Prefecture; the brine pool is in Fengxian County, Jingzhao Prefecture — all are prohibited and not subject to monopoly.

sentences.zh: 烏池在鹽州，舊置榷稅使。

translations.literal: The Black Pool is in Yan Prefecture; a monopoly tax commissioner was formerly established.
translations.idiomatic: The Black Pool is in Yan Prefecture; a monopoly tax commissioner was formerly established.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年三月，敕烏池每年糶鹽收博榷米，以一十五萬石為定額。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Changqing, an edict fixed annual salt sales and monopoly grain collection from the Black Pool at one hundred fifty thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Changqing 1 (821), an edict fixed annual salt sales and monopoly grain collection from the Black Pool at one hundred fifty thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 溫池，大中四年三月因收復河隴，敕令度支收管。

translations.literal: The Warm Pool — in the third month of the fourth year of Dazhong, because the Hexi region was recovered, an edict ordered the Revenue Office to take charge.
translations.idiomatic: The Warm Pool — in the third month of Dazhong 4 (850), because the Hexi region was recovered, an edict ordered the Revenue Office to take charge.

sentences.zh: 溫池鹽仍差靈州分巡院官勾當。

translations.literal: Salt from the Warm Pool was still entrusted to an official of the Ling Prefecture branch patrol office to manage.
translations.idiomatic: Salt from the Warm Pool was still entrusted to an official of the Ling Prefecture branch patrol office to manage.

sentences.zh: 至六年三月，敕令割屬威州，置榷稅使。

translations.literal: By the third month of the sixth year, an edict ordered it transferred to Wei Prefecture and a monopoly tax commissioner established.
translations.idiomatic: By the third month of the sixth year, an edict ordered it transferred to Wei Prefecture and a monopoly tax commissioner established.

sentences.zh: 緣新制置，未立榷課定額。

translations.literal: Because the new establishment had not yet fixed a monopoly quota.
translations.idiomatic: Because the new establishment had not yet fixed a monopoly quota.

sentences.zh: 胡落池在豐州界，河東供軍使收管。

translations.literal: Haluo Pool is on the border of Feng Prefecture; the Hedong Army Supply Commissioner managed it.
translations.idiomatic: Haluo Pool is on the border of Feng Prefecture; the Hedong Army Supply Commissioner managed it.

sentences.zh: 每年采鹽約一萬四千余石，供振武、天德兩軍及營田水運官健。

translations.literal: Each year about fourteen thousand-plus shi of salt were harvested, supplying the Zhenwu and Tiande armies and the garrison farm and water-transport official troops.
translations.idiomatic: Each year about fourteen thousand-plus shi of salt were harvested, supplying the Zhenwu and Tiande armies and the garrison farm and water-transport official troops.

sentences.zh: 自大中四年党項叛擾，饋運不通，供軍使請權市河東白池鹽供食。

translations.literal: From the fourth year of Dazhong, when the Tangut rebelled and harassed the frontier and supply routes were cut, the Army Supply Commissioner requested permission to purchase salt from the White Pool in Hedong to feed the troops.
translations.idiomatic: From Dazhong 4 (850), when the Tangut rebelled and harassed the frontier and supply routes were cut, the Army Supply Commissioner requested permission to purchase salt from the White Pool in Hedong to feed the troops.

sentences.zh: 其白池屬河節度使，不系度支。

translations.literal: The White Pool belonged to the Yellow River military commissioner and was not under the Revenue Office.
translations.idiomatic: The White Pool belonged to the Yellow River military commissioner and was not under the Revenue Office.

sentences.zh: 初，玄宗已前，亦有鹽池使。

translations.literal: Earlier, before Emperor Xuanzong, there were also salt pool commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, before Emperor Xuanzong, there were also salt pool commissioners.

sentences.zh: 景雲四年三月，蒲州刺史充關內鹽池使。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Jingyun, the Pu Prefecture governor served concurrently as Guannei Salt Pool Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Jingyun 4 (713), the Pu Prefecture governor served concurrently as Guannei Salt Pool Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 先天二年九月，強循除豳州刺史，充鹽池使，此即鹽州池也。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Xiantian, Qiang Xun was appointed Prefect of Bin and served as Salt Pool Commissioner — this was the Yan Prefecture pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Xiantian 2 (713), Qiang Xun was appointed Prefect of Bin and served as Salt Pool Commissioner — this was the Yan Prefecture pool.

sentences.zh: 開元十五年五月，兵部尚書蕭嵩除關內鹽池使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year of Kaiyuan, Xiao Song, Minister of War, was appointed Guannei Salt Pool Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Kaiyuan 15 (727), Xiao Song, Minister of War, was appointed Guannei Salt Pool Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 此是朔方節度常帶鹽池使也。

translations.literal: This was the salt pool commissionership regularly held by the Shuofang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: This was the salt pool commissionership regularly held by the Shuofang military commissioner.
